title: Membership Tier Rollout

blocks.text: Owner: platform team. Status: in review.
Move the tier matrix off the hand-maintained sheet and into the billing service.
Close the gap where Pro and Normal share a single entitlement row.
Ship to all regions at once on the first of the month.
Billing cutover happens in the same window.
A failed cutover leaves entitlements ambiguous for existing subscribers.
The sheet has no audit trail, so divergence is silent.
Do grandfathered accounts keep the old matrix?
Who owns the entitlement table after handover?

_note: orphaned_blocks is written by the API, never by the agent. It is the fixture's ground truth for LH-02 and is what detects_orphans_if_any reads.
